method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free non-exhaustive in-memory MutationTerminalState enum, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No mutation record, transition engine, dependent-mutation blocking, reconciliation execution, retry/idempotency policy, persistence, serialization, transport mapping, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, exact four-state baseline fidelity, non-exhaustive compatibility choice, UNKNOWN_OUTCOME non-success semantics, absence of transition/reconciliation/persistence behavior, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the mutation-terminal-state implementation commits; no persisted mutation record, transition engine, retry state, reconciliation state, transport contract, or user data depends on this Grain.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free non-exhaustive MutationTerminalState enum covering the four planned terminal states already fixed by docs/DATA_MODEL.md, without defining mutation records, transition rules, dependent-mutation blocking, reconciliation execution, retry/idempotency policy, serialization, persistence, or transport semantics.
rationale: docs/DATA_MODEL.md fixes the planned mutation terminal states as COMMITTED, REJECTED, FAILED, and UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and states that unknown outcome is not success. This Grain adds only the typed terminal-state distinction so later mutation/reconciliation Grains can build on a bounded vocabulary without inventing transition, retry, persistence, or orchestration behavior.
title: Add baseline mutation terminal state primitive
